source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: An enemy unit that performs a [fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back) while [engaged](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) with your unit is forced into the **desperate escape mode**; **MONSTER** and **VEHICLE** units are exempt. If the escaping unit is **battle-shocked**, subtract 1 from its [hazard rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hazard-rolls) for that move. The card says “your unit” rather than “this unit”, so it leaves open whether engagement with any of your units counts or only with the Wulfen.

trigger.event: enemy unit makes a fall-back move

clauses.appliesTo: hazard rolls for that fall-back move
